caliber.hold: mean over evaluator-valid hold steps of the control-step sample; quasi-static caliber; resolution 20 ms (1 control step, 10 x 2 ms sim substeps)
caliber.peak_control_step: max over the lift window of the control-step sample; resolution 20 ms; CANNOT see a frame-internal spike
caliber.peak_substep: max over the lift window of the intra-frame maximum; resolution 2 ms (the sim timestep), sampled at the END of each completed mj_step
caliber.alignment: a probe that samples BEFORE mj_step instead of after is offset by one substep (2 ms): its index i corresponds to ours i-1
